general.name: WireGuard - Restart Unhealthy Tunnel [Win]
general.description: Restarts a WireGuard for Windows tunnel service only if it is unhealthy and meant to be running, then confirms a peer handshakes. https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components

variables.name: usrWgTunnel
variables.description: Required. The tunnel's name as the WireGuard app shows it.

variables.name: usrMode
variables.description: If unhealthy: restart only when the tunnel fails the health check, with the cooldown. Always: restart even if healthy, ignoring the cooldown.

variables.name: usrHandshakeMaxAgeSec
variables.description: 150-3600. A peer whose last handshake is older than this is stale. Match the Connection Health monitor.

variables.name: usrVerifySec
variables.description: 10-120. Seconds to wait after the restart for a peer to handshake.

variables.name: usrCooldownMin
variables.description: 0-1440. Do not restart again within this many minutes of the last restart by this component. 0 turns it off.

variables.name: usrPingTarget
variables.description: Optional. Far-side IP or hostname to ping after the restart, to prompt a handshake. Empty: an address from each peer's allowed IPs.
